{{pkmn|Coordinator}} |enva=Karen Strassman[https://twitter.com/karenstrassman/status/1393347915632963585 Karen Strassman on Twitter] ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) |jpva=Yuki KaidaNintendo DREAM (vol. 329) ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) }} {{Character Infobox/Team |color={{ghost color light}} |member=[[Sinnoh League]] |rank=[[Gym Leader]] |domain=[[Hearthome Gym]] |reward={{badge|Relic}} |specialty={{t|Ghost}} types }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{ghost color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon the Series]]'' |debut=''[[DP093|Playing the Leveling Field!]]'' |enva=[[Erica Schroeder|Bella Hudson]] |jpva=[[Kikuko Inoue]] }} |} '''Fantina''' (Japanese: '''メリッサ''' ''Melissa'') is a sophisticated {{pkmn|Trainer}} and {{pkmn|Coordinator}} who [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Ghost}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. She is the [[Gym Leader]] of [[Hearthome City]]'s [[Gym]], known officially as the [[Hearthome Gym]], and hands out the {{Badge|Relic}} to those who defeat her. An expert in [[Pokémon Contest]]s, she usually competes in [[Rank (Contest)|Master Rank]] {{pkmn|Super Contest}}s and is a member of the [[Ribbon Syndicate]]. She is apparently not from the country the games are set in, and often peppers her speech with phrases of {{wp|French language|French}} (English in the Japanese and French versions). ==In the core series games== Fantina speaks a mix of French and broken English (only broken Japanese in Japanese version, broken French with English in French version) and is from another country. Upon arriving in Sinnoh, she decided to become a Pokémon Contest performer, so she dresses up in fancy outfits for Contests. She considers herself to be a Contest Expert and can occasionally be competed against in {{pkmn|Super Contest}}s{{sup/4|DPPt}}/[[Super Contest Show]]s{{sup/8|BDSP}}, in which she uses her {{p|Drifblim}}, nicknamed '''Loony''' (Japanese: '''ばるん''' ''Balloon''). She also studied Pokémon and eventually attained the title of Gym Leader. Fantina uses {{type|Ghost}} Pokémon in her battles. For defeating her, Trainers receive the {{Badge|Relic}}, {{TM|65|Shadow Claw}}, and are able to use {{m|Surf}}{{sup/4|DP}}{{sup/8|BDSP}}/{{m|Defog}}{{sup/4|Pt}} outside of battle. In {{2v2|Diamond|Pearl}} and {{pkmn|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}}, she cannot be challenged until after the {{player}} has received [[HM03]]{{sup/4|DP}}/[[TM95]]{{sup/8|BDSP}} ({{m|Surf}}) from [[Professor Carolina|Cynthia's grandmother]] in [[Celestic Town]]. In {{v2|Platinum}}, she is battled much earlier in the game and will make her Gym available to players as soon as they talk to her at the Contest Hall. She can be battled again at the [[Battleground]] and occasionally visits the [[Villa]]. Fantina claims to be a fan of [[Dahlia]]'s dancing style and a member of the [[Ribbon Syndicate]] of the [[Resort Area]]. She also mentions making regular visits to the [[Lost Tower]]. Fantina also appears in {{B2W2}}, taking part in the [[Pokémon World Tournament]]. She can be faced in the [[Sinnoh Leaders Tournament|Sinnoh Leaders]], [[Type Expert Tournament|Type Expert]], and [[World Leaders Tournament]]s. In {{g|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}}, Fantina also appears at the {{si|Battle Tower}}, where she can team up with [[Gardenia]] in a [[Double Battle]]. ===Pokémon=== ===={{game|Diamond and Shining Pearl}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Fantina/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Fantina anime.png|thumb|left|250px|Fantina in {{aniseries|DP}}]] ====''Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl''==== Despite {{ashfr|the group}} having traveled through [[Hearthome City]] twice, once in ''[[DP049|Dawn's Early Night!]]'' and a second time in ''[[DP086|Arriving in Style!]]'', the [[Hearthome Gym]] remained closed with the [[Gym Leader]] nowhere in sight. Fantina had left a note saying that she was going on a journey for a while, and to not look for her. She finally appeared in ''[[DP093|Playing The Leveling Field!]]'', where she had a practice [[Contest Battle]] with [[Zoey]]. Although she won the battle with relative ease, she complimented Zoey on her skills and said that she was a formidable opponent. She later battled and defeated {{Ash}}, the defeat prompting him to come up with a special tactic to counter Fantina's Pokémon's {{status|sleep}}-inducing skills, which Fantina dubbed the [[Counter Shield]]. In her debut episode, it was revealed that as soon as she arrived in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]] she decided to take part in [[Pokémon Contest]]s. She excelled at them and, with the help of her {{p|Misdreavus}}, she was able to win the [[Grand Festival]]. After becoming a [[Top Coordinator]], she was invited to assume the position of Gym Leader for Hearthome City's new [[Gym|Pokémon Gym]], which she accepted. As a Gym Leader she was faced with new responsibilities and her desire was to offer a good battle to the many {{pkmn|Trainer}}s who would come to challenge her. In order to achieve that goal, she went on a {{pkmn|journey}} to develop a unique battle style, combining the raw power of regular battles with the stylish moves of Pokémon Contests, and that was her reason for temporarily leaving the Gym. It was also revealed that she battled [[Alan]] twice with him winning the [[Rematch|second time]] after [[Evolution|evolving]] his {{p|Nosepass}}. In ''[[DP100|Aiding the Enemy!]]'', it was revealed that [[Paul]] had managed to defeat her. In ''[[DP101|Barry's Busting Out All Over!]]'', Ash met with Fantina upon returning to Hearthome City. In ''[[DP102|Shield with a Twist!]]'', he had an official Gym battle against her, where he defeated her and earned the {{badge|Relic}}, his fifth [[Sinnoh League]] Badge overall. In ''[[DP157|Gotta Get a Gible!]]'', it was revealed that Fantina had once again left her Gym, so {{an|Barry}} had to take a number in order to battle her when she came back. [[File:Sinnoh Grand Festival Judges.png|thumb|300px|Fantina in the panel of judges]] Fantina appeared from ''[[DP174|Last Call — First Round!]]'' to ''[[DP177|A Grand Fight for Winning!]]'', having yet again left the Gym in order to join [[Raoul Contesta|Mr. Contesta]], [[Mr. Sukizo]], and [[Nurse Joy]] in the judging panel for the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]] as a special guest [[Contest Judge|judge]]. Fantina was very excited throughout the competition and on some occasions she would rise from her seat to comment on a [[Contest combination|combination]] she felt was impressive. After the final battle between Dawn and Zoey, she was the one who handed Zoey the [[Ribbon Cup]]. ====[[Pokémon movie]]s==== She made a cameo appearance in the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. ====Character==== As a [[Top Coordinator]] who is also a [[Gym Leader]], Fantina possesses experiences from different fields and can be quite challenging. Whether competing in [[Pokémon Contest]]s or facing challengers at the [[Hearthome Gym]], she prioritizes stylish techniques. She also likes to use moves that may inflict [[status condition]]s, such as {{m|Hypnosis}} and {{m|Psybeam}}. Fantina has a tendency to break into dance regularly and she is also known for including {{tt|French|English in Japan}} words in her sentences, such as "{{tt|s'il vous plaît|please}}". As evidenced by her clothing and demeanor, she has a flamboyant personality. She likes to see that trait in others as well, as shown when she praised [[Jessie|Jessilina]]'s performance during the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]]. ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Fantina's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Fantina |pkmn=Mismagius |type1=Ghost |stage1=Misdreavus |img=Fantina Misdreavus.png |cap=Fantina's Misdreavus |img2=Fantina Mismagius.png |epnum=DP093 |epname=Playing The Leveling Field! |vajp=Chinami Nishimura |vaen=Sarah Natochenny |desc={{p|Mismagius}} is one of Fantina's main Pokémon. It was first seen in ''[[DP093|Playing The Leveling Field!]]'', where it was taking part in a [[Contest Battle]] against [[Zoey's Glameow]]. It was ultimately able to easily defeat the {{pkmn|category|Catty Pokémon}} by using [[Contest combination|combination moves]]. It was seen later when Fantina was with {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} in the [[Pokémon Center]]. It reappeared in ''[[DP101|Barry's Busting Out All Over!]]'', when Fantina used it in battle against {{TRT}}. It reappeared again in ''[[DP102|Shield with a Twist!]]'' as one of the Pokémon used by Fantina against Ash. During their [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}}, Mismagius faced off against [[Ash's Chimchar]], where, like Gengar, it was unable to withstand the [[Counter Shield]] and was eventually [[Fainting|knocked out]]. Mismagius's known moves are {{m|Psybeam}}, {{m|Magical Leaf}}, {{m|Psywave}}, and {{m|Dark Pulse}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Fantina |pkmn=Drifblim |egg=yes |stage1=Drifloon |type1=Ghost |type2=Flying |main=yes |img=Fantina Drifblim.png |epnum=DP093 |epname=Playing The Leveling Field! |vajp=Miyako Itō |vaen=Erica Schroeder{{!}}Bella Hudson |desc={{p|Drifblim}} is Fantina's main Pokémon, having raised it since it was an {{pkmn|Egg}}. Denise Reis ([[DP174]]-[[DP177]]) }} ===GOTCHA!=== Fantina briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== ===Pocket Monsters DP=== Fantina appeared in a flashback in [[PMDP07]]. ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Fantina Byron Adventures.png|thumb|225px|Fantina and her {{p|Mismagius}} with [[Byron]] and his {{p|Bronzong}}]] Fantina appeared in ''[[PS351|Perturbed by Pachirisu]]''. When two women were making rude comments about rookie contestants during the [[Rank (Contest)|Master Rank]] contest, she sent out her Drifblim to carry them out and throw them back where the Normal Rank contest was taking place. The next day, Fantina met {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} in person, and transported the trio on her Drifblim to the [[Lost Tower]] just as [[Paka and Uji]] had spotted Platinum. There, Diamond and Pearl treated Fantina to their comedy while Platinum witnessed a battle on the lower floors of the tower. Fantina took the trio to [[Solaceon Town]] afterwards and left. Fantina saved Diamond and Pearl from a fall in [[Celestic Town]], and offered to take the trio back to Hearthome, where they discovered that she was the city's Gym Leader, saying that her studies for the lifetime passion of Pokémon Contests granted her the title. Fantina watched as {{adv|Platinum}} made her way through the quizzes given by the Gym easily and took up the challenge, after which her Drifblim was beaten after [[Platinum's Empoleon]] manipulated it into freezing itself using its own wind. Her Mismagius, however, proved to be much trickier; its {{m|Trick Room}} turned Empoleon's speed against it, and beat it easily. It then trapped Platinum and the borrowed {{adv|Lax}} in an illusion where the Pokémon was in a room full of its favorite sweets and Platinum suffered. Before long though, the girl managed to subvert the illusion in her favor with {{adv|Pearl}}'s help, and defeated the Mismagius. After the battle, Fantina and the trio learned of the disappearance of [[Professor Rowan]] and Platinum's father, [[Mr. Berlitz]]. She lent her Drifblim to the trio to assist with their emergency. She later appeared on the [[Spear Pillar]] with the other Sinnoh Gym Leaders where she fought Team Galactic Commander Saturn along with Roark and together they defeated him. They later fought Cyrus on the top of the Spear Pillar and with the help of her fellow Gym Leaders, they managed to break his Red Chain controlling {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}}. However, it was revealed that the one they destroyed was the artificial one he had made earlier and they were all defeated by him. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Drifblim 2}}{{TrainerPoké |pkmn=Drifblim |trainer=Fantina |main=yes |gender=female |type1=Ghost |type2=Flying |img=Fantina Drifblim Adventures.png |epnum=PS351 |epname=Perturbed by Pachirisu |desc={{p|Drifblim}} is the first Pokémon seen on Fantina's team and is her main mode of transportation. Drifblim first appears after Platinum wins her first Pokémon Contest where she throws the two women who attempted to sabotage her Contest in the trash. Drifblim is used to take {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} to the Lost Tower and later appears at the Celestic Ruins where she saves Diamond and Pearl's lives after they fall off of a stone pillar created by Cyrus' Probopass. Fantina used her in her Gym battle against Platinum where she fought her Empoleon, and despite putting up a good fight, was defeated when Empoleon used her Blizzard to freeze her. Fantina lent her to Platinum after she learned that her father had gone missing. Drifblim was later lent to Diamond who used her in a failed attempt to stop Team Galactic from capturing {{p|Mesprit}}. Drifblim returned to her Trainer when the Gym Leaders arrived to confront Cyrus at the Spear Pillar.}} {{anchor|Mismagius 2}}{{TrainerPoké |pkmn=Mismagius |trainer=Fantina |gender=female |type1=Ghost |img=Fantina Mismagius Adventures.png |epnum=PS351 |epname=Perturbed by Pachirisu |desc={{p|Mismagius}} is Fantina's strongest Pokémon and main battler. Mismagius was first seen watching Fantina's Drifblim throw the two women in the trash after they attempted to sabotage Platinum's Contest challenge. She was used to battle Platinum in her Gym battle and she fought the Munchlax she borrowed from Diamond, using her powers to create powerful illusions before eventually being defeated by his {{m|Fling}}. She was later used to battle [[Saturn]]'s Pokémon on the Spear Pillar and later fought Cyrus in order to destroy the first [[Red Chain]]. Mismagius's known moves are {{m|Trick Room}}, {{m|Dark Pulse}}, and {{m|Energy Ball}}, and her Ability is {{a|Levitate}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |pkmn=Duskull |trainer=Fantina |gender=female |type1=Ghost |img=Fantina Duskull Adventures.png |epnum=PS370 |epname=Problematic Probopass and Mad Magnezone III |desc={{p|Duskull}} was first seen rescuing Diamond and Pearl after they fell off a pillar created Cyrus' Probopass. Fantina used her against Platinum's Munchlax in their Gym battle, where she was easily defeated by Munchlax's {{m|Lick}} attack. She was later used to battle Saturn's Pokémon on the Spear Pillar alongside Mismagius. None of Duskull's moves are known, and her Ability is {{a|Levitate}}.}} ===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!=== In ''[[DPA07|Dialga's Secret Keys]]'', Fantina was handing a Badge to [[Hareta]].
